accessanalyzer.title: Security services
accessanalyzer.covered: RAM sharing with auto-accept in an organization, WAF v2 with lock tokens and capacity, Security Hub, Detective, Inspector, Macie, Access Analyzer, Network Firewall, CloudHSM, Control Tower, Account, Service Quotas (default and applied quotas for API Gateway, CloudFormation, DynamoDB, EC2, ECR, ECS, EventBridge, IAM, Lambda, CloudWatch Logs, RDS, S3 and Step Functions, each from an AWS documentation page, with paging; increase requests stay PENDING)

accesscontextmanager.title: VPC Service Controls
accesscontextmanager.covered: v1 REST at `/accesscontextmanager/v1/` (`google.golang.org/api/accesscontextmanager/v1`, Terraform `google_access_context_manager_access_policy` and `google_access_context_manager_service_perimeter`): access policies (a server-made numeric id, `parent` and `title` required) and service perimeters under them, with finished operations, get, patch and delete
accesscontextmanager.not_yet: no perimeter is enforced: no request is ever blocked, and dry-run results, access levels, ingress and egress rules and IAM on a policy are not served; the organization id is not checked

account.title: Security services
account.covered: RAM sharing with auto-accept in an organization, WAF v2 with lock tokens and capacity, Security Hub, Detective, Inspector, Macie, Access Analyzer, Network Firewall, CloudHSM, Control Tower, Account, Service Quotas (default and applied quotas for API Gateway, CloudFormation, DynamoDB, EC2, ECR, ECS, EventBridge, IAM, Lambda, CloudWatch Logs, RDS, S3 and Step Functions, each from an AWS documentation page, with paging; increase requests stay PENDING)
account.not_yet: no findings, no request filtering; Service Quotas lists no quotas yet for other services (SQS, SNS, Kinesis, Secrets Manager and more; their AWS pages show no quota code or the value differs by Region), and an applied quota is always the default

acm.title: ACM, Route 53, EC2 network, Tagging
acm.covered: certificates, hosted zones and records (a private zone answers DNS for the containers pogi starts in its VPC: EC2 instances, ECS tasks, Lambda functions with a VpcConfig and Batch jobs resolve its A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, SRV, PTR, NS and SOA records, wildcards and aliases, and Cloud Map names, while every other name goes to the host's resolver), VPCs/subnets/security groups with a default VPC, route tables and routes, internet and egress-only gateways, Elastic IPs, NAT gateways (with their Elastic IP and network interface), network interfaces (instances show theirs), VPC endpoints (gateway routes, interface addresses), AWS and managed prefix lists, network ACLs and entries, tagging across services (queues, log groups, rules, API keys, functions, tables and more)
acm.not_yet: ACM certificates are issued at once, also with EMAIL validation (no approval step); network ACL and route rules do not filter traffic; private-zone names resolve only inside containers started in the zone's VPC, not on the host, not in containers outside a VPC, and not where a Linux engine without a VM puts containers on the host's network; routing policies (weighted, failover, latency, geolocation) are not evaluated, the first record set of a name answers; where the host has no /etc/resolv.conf (Windows) names outside private zones fail with SERVFAIL; DescribeVpcEndpointServices, peering connections as resources

acm-pca.title: Private CA
acm-pca.covered: certificate authorities (root or subordinate, always PENDING_CERTIFICATE) with a real PEM certificate signing request, tags and the settings you send; `aws_acmpca_certificate_authority` applies, plans without drift and destroys
acm-pca.not_yet: no certificate is issued or signed: `IssueCertificate`, `ImportCertificateAuthorityCertificate` and revocation lists are not served, so an authority never becomes ACTIVE; a deleted authority is removed at once, not kept until its restore period ends

alloydb.title: AlloyDB
alloydb.covered: v1 REST at `/alloydb/v1/` (`google.golang.org/api/alloydb/v1`, Terraform `google_alloydb_cluster` and `google_alloydb_instance`): clusters and the instances in them (create, get, list, patch, delete) with `READY` at once, cluster type `PRIMARY` and a finished operation to poll; labels, paging and `filter`
alloydb.not_yet: nothing runs behind an instance: no PostgreSQL server answers, and no IP address is reported. Backups, restore, failover, promote, read pool resizing and users answer UNIMPLEMENTED or are not stored

amp.title: Config, Managed Prometheus, RUM, OAM
amp.covered: Config recorders, rules and evaluations; Prometheus remote write with a PromQL subset (selectors, rate, sum by)

amplify.title: Amplify
amplify.covered: apps (with a default domain) and branches, tags, and the checks that a branch has an app
amplify.not_yet: nothing is built, deployed or hosted; no jobs run

analyticshub.title: Analytics Hub
analyticshub.covered: v1 REST at `/analyticshub/v1/`, Terraform `google_bigquery_analytics_hub_data_exchange`: data exchanges and their listings, and query templates (create, get, list, patch, delete), with a finished operation to poll where the API has one; labels, paging and `filter`
analyticshub.not_yet: nobody can subscribe: subscribe and the other custom actions answer UNIMPLEMENTED, no BigQuery dataset is shared, and the IAM policy of an exchange is not stored

apigateway.title: API Gateway v1 + v2
apigateway.covered: REST and HTTP APIs, Lambda proxy (payload 1.0/2.0), HTTP proxy, mock, `AWS` integrations to Lambda and to other services (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, Kinesis, Step Functions, S3 and more, with path and action URIs, request parameters and `selectionPattern` by status code), mapping templates in VTL (`#set`, `#if`, `#foreach`, `$input`, `$util`, `$context`, `$stageVariables`), custom domain names and base path mappings (REST, and HTTP with API mappings) reached by Host header or `*.localhost`, stage method settings (`~1` and `~0` paths), Lambda/JWT/Cognito authorizers, API keys and usage plans, CORS, OpenAPI import (API key security, warnings, `failonwarnings`)
apigateway.not_yet: WebSocket invoke, VTL `#macro`, the role of an `AWS` integration (`credentials`) is not assumed, custom domain certificates are not checked and domains answer over HTTP only; `AWS_IAM` routes need a SigV4-signed request but the signature and the caller's permissions are not checked; a RestApi resource policy is enforced for `Deny` statements only (no implicit deny)

apigee.title: Apigee
apigee.covered:
v1 REST at `/apigee/v1/` (`google.golang.org/api/apigee/v1`, Terraform `google_apigee_organization`, `_environment`, `_envgroup`, `_developer` and `_api_product`): an organization named after its project (`POST /organizations?parent=projects/

`), environments, environment groups, API products, developers (named by email), app groups, target servers, key stores, key-value maps, spaces and instances as the API sends them, create, read, update, delete and lists, as finished long-running operations where the API has them
apigee.not_yet: no API proxy runs: proxy bundles, deployments, traffic, analytics, keys, quotas and security checks are not served, and an organization has no runtime or network. Calls the engine does not know answer UNIMPLEMENTED

apihub.title: API hub
apihub.covered: v1 REST at `/apihub/v1/` (`google.golang.org/api/apihub/v1`, Terraform `google_apihub_api_hub_instance`): the API hub instance, APIs, versions, operations, specs, deployments, dependencies, attributes, plugins and runtime project attachments, create with the id in the `<x>Id` parameter, get, list, patch and delete
apihub.not_yet: nothing is parsed or synced: specs are stored as sent, there is no search, lint or plugin run, and a runtime project is not looked at

apikeys.title: API Keys
apikeys.covered: v2 REST at `/apikeys/v2/` (`google.golang.org/api/apikeys/v2`, Terraform `google_apikeys_key`): keys (create with `keyId`, get, list, patch, delete) with finished operations, restrictions stored, and `getKeyString` returning a made-up `AIza...` string that is the same on every read
apikeys.not_yet: keys are not checked anywhere: no API call is allowed or refused by a key or its restrictions. A deleted key is gone at once (the real service keeps it for 30 days), and `undelete` and `lookupKey` answer UNIMPLEMENTED

apim.title: API Management
apim.covered: the management plane (services, APIs with operations, policies and schemas, backends, products with their APIs and policies, subscriptions with primary and secondary keys and `listSecrets`, named values, the service-level policy) and the gateway at `<service>.azure-api.localhost:7644/<api path>` or `/_azure/apim/<service>/…`: API and operation matching by path, method and URL template, subscription keys, policies in order service → product → API → operation with `<base/>`, forwarding to the backend; policies `set-header`, `set-query-parameter`, `rewrite-uri`, `set-backend-service`, `rate-limit`, `rate-limit-by-key`, `validate-jwt` (pogi's Entra tokens work), `return-response`, `mock-response`, `cors`, `set-body`
apim.not_yet: OpenAPI and WSDL import, the C# policy expression language (a few `context.Request.Headers` forms only), other policies (`choose`, `send-request`, `quota`, caching, `retry`) are skipped, `on-error` sections, rate limits are a fixed window kept in memory

appconfig.title: AppConfig
appconfig.covered: applications, environments, profiles, hosted versions with JSON Schema validators, deployments and strategies, the data plane (`StartConfigurationSession` and `GetLatestConfiguration`, as Ion text when `Accept` asks for it), feature flags, extensions

appengine.title: App Engine
appengine.covered: v1 REST at `/appengine/v1/` (`google.golang.org/api/appengine/v1`, Terraform `google_app_engine_application`): the application of a project (`apps.create` with the project as `id` and a `locationId`, then get and patch), served at `apps/<project>`, with its finished operation at `apps/<project>/operations/<id>`, a `defaultHostname` and `SERVING` status
appengine.not_yet: no code runs and nothing answers at `<project>.appspot.com`: services, versions, instances, firewall rules, domain mappings and certificates are not served (a version needs code to deploy), and `apps.repair` and traffic splitting have no effect

appflow.title: AppFlow
appflow.covered: flows (an S3 to S3 flow with its tasks and trigger, ACTIVE at once), connector profiles (the properties read back, the credentials are kept and never returned), a registered custom connector, tags; `aws_appflow_flow` and `aws_appflow_connector_profile` apply, plan without drift and destroy
appflow.not_yet: no flow runs and no data moves: starting a flow records nothing, and there are no execution records, schedules or field checks against a real source; one custom connector can be registered per account and region

apphub.title: App Hub
apphub.covered: v1 REST at `/apphub/v1/` (`google.golang.org/api/apphub/v1`, Terraform `google_apphub_application`): applications with their services and workloads, and service project attachments, as finished long-running operations, with the state `ACTIVE`
apphub.not_yet: no resource is discovered: the lists of discovered services and workloads are empty, and what an application holds is not checked against real resources

appintegrations.title: Amazon AppIntegrations Service
appintegrations.covered: 14 more services, beyond the rows above, emulated from their botocore models by one engine: create, describe, list, update, tags, paging, required-member checks and the models' own errors. appintegrations.not_yet: per-service behavior beyond the services named in the other rows is bookkeeping

application-autoscaling.title: Auto Scaling + Application Auto Scaling

appstream.covered: stacks (create, describe, update, delete, tags) over the CBOR protocol; `aws_appstream_stack` applies, plans without drift and destroys
appstream.not_yet: no streaming session runs: fleets, image builders, images, users and entitlements are not tested; a stack is not checked against a fleet

appsync.title: AppSync
appsync.covered: GraphQL APIs with API key, Cognito, IAM, OIDC and Lambda auth; Lambda, DynamoDB, HTTP, NONE and RDS data sources; VTL and APPSYNC_JS resolvers, pipelines; subscriptions over the real-time WebSocket protocol with argument filters; introspection
appsync.not_yet: sibling fields resolve serially, no caching, enhanced filters

arm.title: Resource Manager, Entra ID, Managed Identity, Graph
arm.covered: the ARM control plane (metadata endpoint, subscriptions, resource groups, providers, asynchronous operations, generic resources); ARM template deployments that run (`az deployment group create` and `az deployment sub create`, Bicep files too, as `az` compiles them): at resource group or subscription scope, the resources are made in `dependsOn` order through pogi's own handlers, so policies and every service apply, with parameters (types, defaults, allowed values, lengths and ranges), variables, `copy` loops of resources, properties, variables and outputs, conditions, nested resources, extension resources with `scope`, nested deployments (Bicep modules, into other groups too), languageVersion 2.0 symbolic names and `existing` resources, outputs, and the common template functions (`resourceId` and its kin, `reference`, `list*` such as `listKeys`, `copyIndex`, `uniqueString`, `guid`, `format`, `concat`, `if`, `union` and the other string, array, object, comparison, logical and number functions); a deployment ends Succeeded, or Failed with the error of the resource that failed, with an operation per resource, and `validate` checks a template without making anything; Resource Graph queries (`az graph query`) over the `Resources` and `ResourceContainers` tables with Azure Monitor's KQL subset, paged with `$top`, `$skip` and `$skipToken`, as objects or a table; Entra tokens for client secrets and assertions, passwords, refresh and device code with JWKS; IMDS and App Service managed identity; Graph applications, service principals, users and groups
arm.not_yet: a deployment runs inside its PUT, one resource at a time, and nothing is rolled back when one fails (Azure doesn't either, unless asked); what-if always reports no changes; not supported in templates: linked templates and template specs, Complete mode, user-defined and lambda functions (`filter`, `map`, `reduce`, `sort`, `toObject`), `dateTimeAdd` and the `uri` functions, Key Vault references in parameters, management group and tenant scope; `uniqueString` and `guid` give stable values, but not the ones Azure computes. A PUT of a resource type pogi does not know is refused (`InvalidResourceType`, or `NoRegisteredProviderFound` for an unknown namespace), Graph covers what `azuread` and `az ad` use. Resource Graph needs the `azmonitor` service on, has no other tables (such as `PolicyResources`), no `join` or `mv-expand`, and child resources such as subnets are not rows of their own

artifactregistry.title: Artifact Registry
artifactregistry.covered: v1 (gRPC and REST): repositories (create, get, list, update, delete, IAM) and Docker images on ECR's OCI registry: `docker push` and `pull` at `localhost:4510/<project>/<repo>/<image>`, and `<region>-docker.pkg.dev/<project>/<repo>/<image>` references run by Cloud Run, ACI and the like are pulled from it; without Docker, metadata only
artifactregistry.not_yet: formats other than Docker (stored as metadata), packages, versions, tags, files and rules, `dockerImages.get`

assuredworkloads.title: Assured Workloads

athena.title: Glue + Athena

athena.not_yet: data is copied per query, no CTAS/INSERT/views, Parquet crawling

autoscaling.title: Auto Scaling + Application Auto Scaling
autoscaling.covered: groups that keep their capacity, simple/step/target-tracking policies driven by CloudWatch alarms, scheduled actions, target-group registration; scalable targets for ECS, DynamoDB and Lambda

azaci.title: Container Instances
azaci.covered: ARM `Microsoft.ContainerInstance/containerGroups`: containers in Docker with image, command, environment, ports, CPU and memory limits and restart policy; the group's IP address and `dnsNameLabel` served at `<label>.<location>.azurecontainer.localhost:7644` and `/_azure/aci/<group>/…`; `instanceView` states, `start`, `stop`, `restart` and container logs; without Docker, groups stay Pending
azaci.not_yet: exec and attach, volumes, probes, GPUs, virtual networks, init containers, identities

azacr.title: Container Registry
azacr.covered: ARM `Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries` on ECR's OCI registry: `<name>.azurecr.localhost:4510` or `localhost:4510/<name>/…`, `docker push` and `pull`, `listCredentials`, and the sign-in endpoints of `az acr login` and `/oauth2/exchange`; ACI and Container Apps pull images from it; without ECR, metadata only

azadvisor.title: Azure Advisor
azadvisor.covered: ARM `Microsoft.Advisor` configurations at a subscription or resource group, from Microsoft's API spec: create, read, update and lists; the recommendations list answers empty, so the `azurerm_advisor_recommendations` data source reads

azaks.title: Kubernetes Service
azaks.covered: ARM `Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters` and `agentPools`: each cluster is a real k3s API server, Creating until its node is Ready, with `fqdn`; `listClusterUserCredential` and `listClusterAdminCredential` return a kubeconfig whose token the API server accepts (the `armcontainerservice` client and `az aks get-credentials`); without Docker, Succeeded at once with no API server
azaks.not_yet: agent pools are metadata and add no nodes, one Kubernetes version, a static bearer token instead of Entra tokens (no kubelogin)

azanalysisservices.title: Analysis Services
azanalysisservices.covered: ARM `Microsoft.AnalysisServices/servers`, from Microsoft's API spec: create, read, update, delete and lists, a server name (`asazure://` address) and a state of `Succeeded`; `azurerm_analysis_services_server` applies, plans without drift and destroys
azanalysisservices.not_yet: no model can be deployed or queried: the server address answers nothing; suspend, resume, firewall rules and administrators are stored and not enforced

azappconfig.title: App Configuration
azappconfig.covered: key-values with labels, filters, ETags, locks, revisions, snapshots, feature flags; HMAC auth

azappgateway.title: Application Gateway
azappgateway.covered: ARM `Microsoft.Network/applicationGateways`, from Microsoft's API spec: create, read, update, delete and lists, ids for the parts sent inline (frontend ports, listeners, pools, rules and the others), `operationalState` Running; `azurerm_application_gateway` applies, plans without drift and destroys
azappgateway.not_yet: nothing runs behind the resource: it is stored and read back, and no traffic flows; no request is routed or probed, the properties are not checked against each other (a rule that names a missing listener is accepted), and backend health and web application firewall rules are not served

azappgwcontainers.title: Application Gateway for Containers
azappgwcontainers.covered: ARM `Microsoft.ServiceNetworking/trafficControllers` with frontends and associations, from Microsoft's API spec: create, read, update, delete and lists, a frontend's host name; `azurerm_application_load_balancer`, `azurerm_application_load_balancer_frontend` and `azurerm_application_load_balancer_subnet_association` apply, plan without drift and destroy (the provider itself waits five minutes before it deletes a controller)
azappgwcontainers.not_yet: nothing runs behind the resource: it is stored and read back, and no traffic flows; no Kubernetes cluster is connected, the subnet of an association is not checked, and security policies are not served

azappservice.title: App Service
azappservice.covered: ARM `Microsoft.Web/serverfarms` and `sites` for web apps (`azurerm_service_plan`, `azurerm_linux_web_app`, `azurerm_windows_web_app`), with the site configuration, app settings, connection strings, publishing credentials and the other configuration `azurerm` reads. azarc.title: Azure Arc
azarc.covered: ARM `Microsoft.HybridCompute` private link scopes, machines and machine extensions, from Microsoft's API spec: create, read, update, delete and lists, a scope's id and its public network access (`Disabled` unless sent); `azurerm_arc_private_link_scope` applies, plans without drift and destroys
azarc.not_yet: no agent connects: there are no connected machines unless you create the resource yourself, no extension runs, and licenses, run commands, gateways and the guest-configuration or update services are not served; private endpoint connections are not served

azautomation.title: Automation
azautomation.covered: ARM `Microsoft.Automation/automationAccounts` and runbooks, from Microsoft's API spec: create, read, update, delete and lists, a runbook's script kept as text (`PUT .../draft/content`, `publish`, `GET .../content`) with its state (`New`, then `Published`); `azurerm_automation_account` and `azurerm_automation_runbook` apply, plan without drift and destroy

azavd.title: Azure Virtual Desktop
azavd.covered: ARM `Microsoft.DesktopVirtualization` host pools, application groups, applications, workspaces and scaling plans, from Microsoft's API spec: create, read, update, delete and lists, as sent; `azurerm_virtual_desktop_host_pool`, `azurerm_virtual_desktop_application_group`, `azurerm_virtual_desktop_application`, `azurerm_virtual_desktop_workspace` and the workspace and application group association apply, plan without drift and destroy
azavd.not_yet: no session host registers and no user connects: session hosts, user sessions, registration tokens, MSIX and app attach packages and private endpoint connections are not served, and a desktop application group has no `default` desktop

azavs.title: Azure VMware Solution
azavs.covered: ARM `Microsoft.AVS` private clouds, clusters, authorizations, global reach connections, HCX enterprise sites and add-ons, from Microsoft's API spec: create (a long-running operation), read, update, delete and lists, the vCenter, NSX-T and HCX addresses, the ExpressRoute circuit and an authorization's id and key; `azurerm_vmware_private_cloud`, `azurerm_vmware_cluster` and `azurerm_vmware_express_route_authorization` apply, plan without drift and destroy
azavs.not_yet: no vSphere runs: the addresses and thumbprints are made up and answer nothing, hosts are never listed, and datastores, workload networking, scripts, placement policies, password rotation and admin credentials are not served

azbastion.title: Bastion
azbastion.covered: ARM `Microsoft.Network/bastionHosts`, from Microsoft's API spec: create, read, update, delete and lists, ids for the IP configurations and the host's DNS name; `azurerm_bastion_host` applies, plans without drift and destroys
azbastion.not_yet: nothing runs behind the resource: it is stored and read back, and no traffic flows; no session can be opened, and the subnet and public IP are not checked

azbatch.title: Azure Batch
azbatch.covered: ARM `Microsoft.Batch/batchAccounts` and `pools`, from Microsoft's API spec: create, read, update, delete and lists, the account's endpoint and quotas, and its primary and secondary keys from `listKeys`; `azurerm_batch_account` and `azurerm_batch_pool` apply, plan without drift and destroy
azbatch.not_yet: no node ever starts: pools have no nodes (always `Steady`, zero nodes), and jobs, tasks, applications and certificates are not served; the Batch data plane does not exist

azblob.title: Blob Storage
azblob.covered: containers, block, append and page blobs, block lists, ranges, metadata, copy, leases, tags (Azurite port 10000)

azchaos.title: Chaos Studio
azchaos.covered: ARM `Microsoft.Chaos` experiments, targets and capabilities, from Microsoft's API spec: create, read, update, delete and lists, on any resource, and a short list of target and capability types per region; `azurerm_chaos_studio_target`, `azurerm_chaos_studio_capability` and `azurerm_chaos_studio_experiment` apply, plan without drift and destroy

azcognitive.title: Cognitive Services
azcognitive.covered: ARM `Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts`, from Microsoft's API spec: create, read, update, delete and lists, an `endpoint` (the custom sub-domain's when there is one), and two keys from `listKeys` that stay the same; `azurerm_cognitive_account` applies, plans without drift and destroys. azcompute.title: Virtual Machines
azcompute.covered: ARM `Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines`, `disks`, `availabilitySets` and `sshPublicKeys`: VMs as containers of the base image their image reference names (Ubuntu, Debian), `customData` run at first boot (a cloud-config `runcmd` subset or a script), `instanceView` power state, `start`, `powerOff`, `deallocate` and `restart`, NIC private IPs from the Virtual Network service, and the instance metadata service (`/metadata/instance` and identity tokens) reachable from inside; Windows and other images, and Docker-less runs, are metadata only

azconfidentialledger.title: Confidential Ledger
azconfidentialledger.covered: ARM `Microsoft.ConfidentialLedger/ledgers`, from Microsoft's API spec: create (a long-running operation), read, update, delete and lists, with the ledger and identity service addresses; `azurerm_confidential_ledger` applies, plans without drift and destroys
azconfidentialledger.not_yet: no ledger runs: the addresses answer nothing, there are no entries, receipts or users, and managed CCF is not served

azcontainerapps.title: Container Apps
azcontainerapps.covered: ARM `Microsoft.App/managedEnvironments`, `containerApps` (with revisions) and `jobs` (with executions): apps as containers behind ingress at `<app>.<env>.azurecontainerapps.localhost:7644`, started on the first request like Cloud Run; a revision per template change, traffic weights in Multiple mode; secrets and env; jobs run on the `start` action with parallelism, retries and timeouts; without Docker, metadata only

azcostmanagement.title: Cost Management
azcostmanagement.covered: ARM budgets (`Microsoft.Consumption/budgets`) and exports and scheduled actions (`Microsoft.CostManagement`), at any scope, from Microsoft's API specs: create, read, update, delete and lists; `azurerm_consumption_budget_subscription` and `azurerm_subscription_cost_management_export` apply, plan without drift and destroy
azcostmanagement.not_yet: no cost is counted: a budget's current spend is never filled, no notification is sent and no export file is written; queries, forecasts, views, alerts and cost allocation rules are not served

azdatabases.title: Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cache for Redis
azdatabases.covered: servers, databases and firewall rules as real engines in containers; Redis keys that work as AUTH passwords
azdatabases.not_yet: configurations are not applied, no TLS

azdatabricks.title: Databricks
azdatabricks.covered: ARM `Microsoft.Databricks/workspaces`, from Microsoft's API spec: create, read, update, delete and lists, a `workspaceUrl`, a `workspaceId`, and the managed resource group id as sent; `azurerm_databricks_workspace` applies, plans without drift and destroys
